column1: NEURO-METRO: AVUI — GAME CONFIG
This workbook is the source of truth for all game content. The prototype reads no
content values of its own — every number, ability, unit and rule comes from here.
HOW THE ROUND TRIP WORKS
1.  Edit any sheet in Google Sheets.
2.  File > Download > Comma-separated values, one CSV per sheet.
3.  Put the CSVs in a folder and run:  python3 tools/build_data.py <folder>
4.  That regenerates data.js. Reload the prototype. Nothing else to touch.
COLUMN STATUS — the row under each header
LIVE      (green)   the prototype reads this column today. Renaming it breaks the game.
planned   (yellow)  reserved for design you have not built yet. Inert until wired up;
safe to fill in early. Tell me when you want one activated.
CONVENTIONS
ids          UPPER_SNAKE. Referenced by other sheets, so renaming one means updating
every sheet that points at it. The 'checks' sheet catches broken references.
lists        pipe-separated in a single cell:  ATK_ANGER|ATK_JOY|DEFEND
booleans     1 or 0  (TRUE/FALSE also accepted)
blank        means 'none' / 'typeless'. An ability with no emotion never matches a layer.
*            wildcard, in the matchups sheet only. Matches any emotion.
enabled      set to 0 to switch a row off without deleting it.
ADDING THINGS — no code needed
a new ability      add a row to 'abilities', then add its id to a unit's pool
a new enemy        add a row to 'units'
a new emotion      add a row to 'emotions' with a hex colour, then matchup rows for it
a new synergy      add a row to 'matchups' — this is the main lever for interactions
retune anything    'rules'
SHEETS
emotions         the six emotional types and their palette colours
abilities        everything a unit can do
matchups         attack emotion x layer emotion -> damage and charge. Your synergy table.
units            player and enemies: stats, starting layers, ability pool
layer_types      per-layer properties. Reserved — layers are plain emotions today.
status_effects   buffs and debuffs. Reserved.
synergies        line-level combos (sequences, counts, positions). Reserved.
dialogue         what each enemy says, per persona and battle state
rules            global tunables
sounds           runtime-synthesised SFX. No audio files.
checks           live validation. Every row should read OK.
